macros.name: abb
macros.doc: Typeset text in one line while removing the height of letters.

macros.name: abcapital
macros.doc: Add a two-colored capital letter with the primary rubrics color for highlighting.

macros.name: abcapitalother
macros.doc: Add a two-colored capital letter with the secondary rubrics color for highlighting.

macros.name: abcursivefamily
macros.doc: Switch to Aboensis with the current size and set text color.

macros.name: abcursiveinitial
macros.doc: Add a cursive initial letter using the text color.

macros.name: abcursiveinitialwithpos
macros.doc: Add a cursive initial letter scaled by scale and moved by xpos and ypos.

macros.name: abdownindex
macros.doc: Add a finger pointing down.

macros.name: abfourth
macros.doc: Add a Swedish symbol for one fourth.

macros.name: abhundred
macros.doc: Add a hundreds marker for the alternative Roman numeral encoding.

macros.name: abindent
macros.doc: Add space equal to the width of the last lombardic initial.

macros.name: abinitial
macros.doc: Add a Lombardic initial letter in the primary rubrics color.

macros.name: abinitialother
macros.doc: Add a Lombardic initial letter in the secondary rubrics color.

macros.name: abinitialothertwo
macros.doc: Add a two-colored Lombardic inititial letter where main color is the secondary rubrics color and the other color is the primary rubrics color.

macros.name: abinitialtwo
macros.doc: Add a two-colored Lombardic inititial letter where main color is the primary rubrics color and the other color is the secondary rubrics color.

macros.name: abinitotwowpos
macros.doc: Add a two-colored Lombardic initial scaled by scale and moved by xpos and ypos.

macros.name: abinitowpos
macros.doc: Add a Lombardic initial letter that is scaled by scale and moved by xpos and ypos.

macros.name: abinittwowpos
macros.doc: Add a two-colored Lombardic initial scaled by scale and moved by xpos and ypos.

macros.name: abinitwpos
macros.doc: Add a Lombardic initial letter that is scaled by scale and moved by xpos and ypos.

macros.name: abitem
macros.doc: Add the ’item’ symbol with text color.

macros.name: abl
macros.doc: Typeset text in one line while removing the height of letters.

macros.name: ableftindex
macros.doc: Add a finger pointing left.

macros.name: aboensis
macros.doc: Sets text in Aboensis with set text color.

macros.name: abothernum
macros.doc: Change the number glyphs in number to the alternate Arabic numbers.

macros.name: abotherrubric
macros.doc: Set text using the secondary rubrics color.

macros.name: abotherrubricblue
macros.doc: Set the secondary rubrics color to blue.

macros.name: abotherrubricgreen
macros.doc: Set the secondary rubrics color to green (default).

macros.name: abotherrubricred
macros.doc: Set the secondary rubrics color to red.

macros.name: abpara
macros.doc: Add the paragraph start pillcrow symbol ¶ in the primary rubrics color.

macros.name: abparaother
macros.doc: Add the paragraph start pillcrow symbol ¶ in the secondary rubrics color.

macros.name: abrightindex
macros.doc: Add a finger pointing right.

macros.name: abroman
macros.doc: Format number as a Roman numeral using the standard subtractive numerals.

macros.name: abromanother
macros.doc: Format a number as a Roman numeral using the alternative shema where thousands and hundreds are shown separately.

macros.name: abrubric
macros.doc: Set text using the primary rubrics color.

macros.name: abrubricblue
macros.doc: Set the primary rubrics color to blue.

macros.name: abrubricgreen
macros.doc: Set the primary rubrics color to green.

macros.name: abrubricred
macros.doc: Set the primary rubrics color to red (default).

macros.name: absetcolormixpercentage
macros.doc: Set the primary rubrics color mix percentage to percentage.

macros.name: absetothercolormixpercentage
macros.doc: Set the secondary rubrics color mix percentage to percentage.

macros.name: absetotherrubriccolor
macros.doc: Set the secondary rubric color to color.

macros.name: absetrubriccolor
macros.doc: Set the primary rubric color to color.

macros.name: absettextcolor
macros.doc: Set the text color to color.

macros.name: absixth
macros.doc: Add a Swedish symbol for one sixth.

macros.name: abstartchapterothertwo
macros.doc: Add a two-line chapter start with a two-colored Lombardic initial where main color is the secondary rubrics color and the other is the primary rubrics color.

macros.name: abstartchapterothertwowithpos
macros.doc: Add a chapter start with a two-line two-color scaled and positioned Lombardic initial where the main color is the secondary rubrics color and other color is the primary rubrics color.

macros.name: abstartchapterotherwithpos
macros.doc: Add a two-line chapter start with a scaled and positioned Lombardic initial in the secondary rubrics color.

macros.name: abstartchaptertwo
macros.doc: Add a two-line chapter start with a two-colored Lombardic initial where main color is the primary rubrics color and the other is the secondary rubrics color.

macros.name: abstartchaptertwowithpos
macros.doc: Add a chapter start with a two-line two-color scaled and positioned Lombardic initial where the main color is the primary rubrics color and other color is the secondary rubrics color.

macros.name: abstartchapterwithpos
macros.doc: Add a two-line chapter start with a scaled and positioned Lombardic initial in the primary rubrics color.

macros.name: abtext
macros.doc: Set text using the text color.

macros.name: abthird
macros.doc: Add a Swedish symbol for one third.

macros.name: abthousand
macros.doc: Add a thousands marker for the alternative Roman numeral encoding.

macros.name: abtildes
macros.doc: Because the tilde ~ and underscore _ are special characters in TeX, there is a command \abtildes that makes them letters so that they can be used for ligature substitutions and as line fillers.

macros.name: abtootherrubric
macros.doc: Change the color to the secondary rubrics color.

macros.name: abtorubric
macros.doc: Change the color to the primary rubrics color.

macros.name: abupindex
macros.doc: Add a finger pointing up.
